verdict.rationale: Kong's documented Vault entity lets you store secrets and reference them from other entities, so secrets aren't visible in plaintext across the platform. Backends include environment variables, Konnect Config Store, and supported third-party vaults, which covers the external-vault path of the story. Missing for 10: no named third-party vault providers or reference syntax for keeping secrets out of declarative/decK files, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
